title: Config
description: rumdl configuration for linting Markdown files. Rules can be configured individually using [MD###] sections with rule-specific options.

extends.description:
Path to a base config file to inherit settings from.
Supports relative paths, absolute paths, `~/` for the home directory, and
`$VAR` / `${VAR}` environment-variable expansion (a literal `$` is written `$$`).
Example: `extends = "../base.rumdl.toml"` or `extends = "$GEM_PATH/base.rumdl.toml"`

per-file-ignores.description:
Per-file rule ignores: maps file patterns to lists of rules to ignore.
Patterns are relative to the project root; a leading `~/` expands to the
home directory and absolute paths are matched as written.
Example: { "README.md": ["MD033"], "docs/**/*.md": ["MD013"] }

per-file-flavor.description:
Per-file flavor overrides: maps file patterns to Markdown flavors.
Patterns are relative to the project root; a leading `~/` expands to the
home directory and absolute paths are matched as written.
Example: { "docs/**/*.md": MkDocs, "**/*.mdx": MDX }
Uses IndexMap to preserve config file order for "first match wins" semantics

code-block-tools.description:
Code block tools configuration for per-language linting and formatting
using external tools like ruff, prettier, shellcheck, etc.

include.description:
Files to include. Glob patterns, relative to the project root; a
leading `~/` expands to the home directory and absolute paths are
matched as written.

exclude.description:
Files to exclude. Glob patterns, relative to the project root; a
leading `~/` expands to the home directory and absolute paths are
matched as written.

respect-gitignore.description:
Respect .gitignore, .ignore and git exclude files when scanning
directories. .markdownlintignore applies regardless, and explicitly
named files bypass both.

\[DEPRECATED\] Whether to enforce exclude patterns for explicitly passed paths.
This option is deprecated as of v0.0.156 and has no effect.
Exclude patterns are now always respected, even for explicitly provided files.
This prevents duplication between rumdl config and tool configs like pre-commit.

Whether to read settings from `.editorconfig` files (default: false).
When enabled, the `.editorconfig` properties that map onto rumdl
settings fill in anything no rumdl config sets, resolved per file so
section globs and nested `.editorconfig` files apply as written.

LineLength.description:
A line length value that can be 0 (meaning no limit) or a positive value (≥1)

Many configuration values for line length need to support both:
- 0: Special value meaning "no line length limit"
- ≥1: Actual line length limit

This type enforces those constraints at deserialization time.

MarkdownFlavor.description: Markdown flavor/dialect. Accepts: standard, gfm, mkdocs, mdx, pandoc, quarto, obsidian, kramdown, azure_devops, myst, hugo, mdg, gh-aw (preview). Aliases: commonmark/github map to standard, qmd/rmd/rmarkdown map to quarto, jekyll maps to kramdown, azure/ado map to azure_devops, mystmd maps to myst, goldmark maps to hugo, markdown_with_gherkin maps to mdg.

CodeBlockToolsConfig.description:
Master configuration for code block tools.

This is disabled by default for safety - users must explicitly enable it.

on-missing-language-definition.description: Behavior when a recognized language has no tools configured in either mode.

on-missing-tool-binary.description:
Behavior when a configured tool's binary is absent from the allowed lookup locations.
Defaults to `warn`: the tools rumdl drives are installed separately from
rumdl, so an absent one is common enough that silence about it is a trap.

binary-preferences.description: Select already-installed project/PATH executables per underlying binary.

tool-version-definition.description: Optional project metadata source for external tool version verification.

on-tool-version-mismatch.description:
Policy for mismatched or unresolved external tool versions.
Defaults to `warn` and runs the tool; `fail` skips only that tool.
Inactive unless a tool-version-definition is configured.

on-missing-language-tag.description: Policy for unlabeled fenced code blocks.

on-unknown-language-tag.description: Policy for unknown tags. When omitted, inherits on-missing-language-definition.

on-missing-mode-definition.description: Policy for a configured language missing tools for the active mode.

on-no-tools-run.description: Invocation-level policy when no tool or valid cached tool check was used.

timeout.description: Timeout per tool execution in milliseconds (default: 30000)

language-aliases.description:
User-defined language aliases (override built-in resolution)
Example: { "py": "python", "bash": "shell" }

oneOf.description: Resolve language aliases using GitHub Linguist data (e.g., "py" -> "python")
Use the language tag exactly as written in the code block

OnError.description: Error handling strategy for tool execution failures.

oneOf.description: Fail the lint/format operation (propagate error)
Continue with the next tool without a warning
Log a warning but continue processing

OnMissing.description: Behavior when a configured coverage or availability condition is unmet.

oneOf.description: Silently skip and continue processing

Emit one configuration warning per condition, then continue.
`--deny-config-warnings` makes the warning fatal.
Report an error and continue; invocation conditions use exit code 2.
Stop immediately on the first occurrence, exit non-zero

BinaryPreference.description: Preference for resolving an external executable. Explicit paths bypass this.

oneOf.description: Prefer the project's virtual environment or node_modules, then PATH.
Prefer PATH, then project-local installations.
Require a project-local installation.
Preserve PATH-only lookup.

ToolVersionDefinition.description: Supported authoritative sources for external tool versions.

oneOf.description: Select the nearest metadata file, preferring resolved versions and hook pins.
Exact resolved Python package versions in the nearest project lockfile.
Declared Python dependency and tool version constraints.
Version-like revisions of supported official pre-commit hook repositories.
Version-like revisions in the alternate pre-commit YAML filename.
Version-like revisions of supported official prek hook repositories.

enabled.description:
Whether code block tools are enabled for this language (default: true).
Set to false to acknowledge a language without configuring tools.
This satisfies strict mode (on-missing-language-definition) checks.

lint.description: Tools to run in lint mode (rumdl check)

format.description: Tools to run in format mode (rumdl check --fix / rumdl fmt)

format-mode.description: How the `format` list is applied: as fallbacks (default) or as a pipeline

on-error.description: Override global on-error setting for this language

FormatMode.description: How a language's `format` list is applied to a code block.

oneOf.description:
Try the formatters in order; the first one that succeeds supplies the
block, even when it changes nothing

Run every formatter in order, each on the output of the last one that
succeeded, and replace the block with the final result

ToolDefinition.description:
Definition of an external tool.

This describes how to invoke a tool and how it communicates.

command.description: Command to run (first element is the binary, rest are arguments)

stdin.description: Whether the tool reads from stdin (default: true)

stdout.description: Whether the tool writes to stdout (default: true)

lint-args.description: Additional arguments for lint mode (appended to command)

format-args.description: Additional arguments for format mode (appended to command)

severity.description: Severity override for this rule (Error, Warning, or Info)

Severity.description:
Severity of the findings a rule reports: `error`, `warning` or `info`.
Matched case-insensitively.
